**Best move:** Qxd7+

**Main line:** 1. Qxd7+ Kf8 2. Qxb7 (winning the bishop; if 2...Qxg2+ 3. Kxg2 and White is up a piece)

**Motif:** fork

**Coaching Note (80 words):**
After Black played Nxg5, your queen on d3 could move to d7 with check. This forces the king to f8 (the only legal move). Then your queen swoops down to b7, winning the undefended bishop. Even if Black gives checks with the queen, you're up a full piece and winning easily. The lesson: when your opponent leaves pieces undefended, look for forcing checks that move your attacking piece closer to the loose enemy piece. Checks are almost free moves—use them!
